questions.question: In the following question, select the odd number pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

1) 9 – 72 → 9 – (9² - 9)

2) 12 – 132 → 12 – (12² - 12)

3) 10 – 90 → 10 – (10² - 10)

4) **5 – 30 → 5 – (5² + 5)**

All follow the same pattern, except ‘5 – 30’

Hence, “5 – 30” is the odd number pair.

questions.question:
From the given alternatives, select the word which CANNOT be formed using the letters of the given word.

RESPIRATION
questions.solution:
PIRATE → R**E**S**PIRAT**ION, hence, word can be formed.

SINE → R**ES**PIRAT**I**O**N**, hence, word can be formed.

POSTER → **RESP**IRA**T**I**O**N, hence, word can be formed.

RIDER → **RE**SP**IR**ATION, since there is no D in the word, the word cannot be formed.

Hence, “RIDER” cannot be formed using letters of the given word.

questions.question:

Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some green are white.

II. Some yellow are green.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some white are yellow

II. Some green are yellow
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac9301f3b8f8591bd6d1f258ec3bf8d7adf419caab64d5bc0d8fe8a2069e5d33.png] 

Conclusion I: Some white are yellow → False (This is definitely false)

Conclusion II: Some green are yellow → True (This is definitely true)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d92fc9a072898409c09d1e3ac713dd9c0ec6d90788ee81242c264734d980c1a.png] 

Hence, “only conclusion II” follows.

questions.question: If P is 200% of Q and R is 400% of Q, then R is how much percent more than P?
questions.solution:
Given,

P is 200% of Q and R is 400% of Q

P = 200/ 100 × Q

P = 2Q

R = 400 / 100 × Q

R = 4Q

R is more than P by = 4Q - 2Q / 2Q × 100

= 2Q / 2Q × 100

= 100

R is 100 % more than P.

Hence, “100” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Ratio of the present ages of Mohan and Ram is 3 : 5 and the difference between their ages is 12 years. What is the present age (in years) of Ram?
questions.solution:
Let the present ages of Mohan and Ram be 3x and 5x

Difference between their ages = 12

5x – 3x = 12

2x = 12

x = 6

Ram’s present age = 5x = 5 × 6 = 30

Hence, “30’ is the correct answer.
